errata.reason: final_thesis.md Part I Headline Scorecard 'Rating cap, if any' cell and the Pre-Write Gate Summary '4. Red-flag cap' line both state only the management-governance module's two High-severity flags (RF-CAP-002, RF-SHR-001) and conclude 'no verdict-lock or Critical red flag' / 'neither is Critical. No verdict lock.' — omitting that the earnings module (08_earnings-red-flags.md, 99_earnings-synthesis.md) declared TWO Critical-severity flags (Anthropic $60.6B Level 3 mark-to-model asset inflating GAAP EPS; D&A-from-AI-capex-wave opacity), verbatim 'Critical concerns' verdict, cited elsewhere in the same document (final_thesis.md lines ~370/379/493/581). The document's own Pre-Write Gate Summary §4B ('Cross-module forensic roll-up') DOES address these two flags and explicitly reconciles them, with stated reasoning, to a 'compound accounting-integrity flag at High level — not Critical (no going-concern risk, no auditor qualification, no fraud evidence)' — a reasoned, evidence-based downgrade consistent with the synthesizer's §22 adjudication role, not a silent drop. But the Headline Scorecard cell and the one-line §4 'Red-flag cap' summary — the two places CLAUDE.md §21 assumes a reader may stop at — give a false all-clear by omitting the earnings-module Critical designation and its reconciliation entirely. This is a CLAUDE.md §13/§22 transparency defect ('expose missing data rather than paper over it'), caught by eval check AK (red-flag severity reconciliation), not a rating error: decision_record.json's decision ('Watchlist') already sits at the §18 cap a Critical flag would impose, module_scores.earnings (75) already narrates the Anthropic/D&A penalty, and no scored field is wrong. No decision_record.json field is changed. Corrected via a one-time, hand-authored ERRATUM banner prepended to final_thesis.md pointing to the existing §4B reconciliation.
